parts.gloss: one who is easy of access

words.gloss: one who is easy of access

literal: To sight easy, harsh-worded if he is not, highly praise will the king's land.
translation: If a king is easy of access and not harsh in speech, the world will highly praise his land.
modern: காண்பதற்கு எளியவனாகவும், கடுமையான சொற்களைப் பேசாதவனாகவும் ஒரு அரசன் இருந்தால், அவனது நாட்டை உலகத்தார் உயர்த்திப் பேசுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights two key qualities of an ideal ruler: accessibility and gentle communication. A leader must be easy for anyone to approach and meet without fear. Additionally, they must refrain from using harsh or offensive language when speaking to others. If a king rules with these qualities, the people of the world will highly praise and extol his land.
